svg.title: Due-date reminders: before a ticket is late, and when it is — SoftTrack web design mockup (#262)
svg.desc: Due dates are on tickets, on the calendar and in a filter, and a date passing causes nothing. Two new kinds of notification come from the calendar: due tomorrow, the day before, and overdue, the day after and once more a week later, each sent in the morning in the person’s timezone.
